panels.description: The security barrier crushes Alex's wrist guard in the shutter track. Show the damaged guard and trapped hand without gore; leave upper space for the impact sound.
A service shutter closes behind Lina as an institutional clerk forces her through the narrowing opening. Lina looks back toward Alex and Ada; leave upper-left clear for her warning.
Ada strikes the barrier glass from the opposite side while Alex reaches toward her. Keep the glass division and both faces clear; leave upper space for her cry.
The white-and-amber node above the barrier flashes the two status lines. Alex is trapped in foreground behind the barrier; leave the display unobstructed for lettering.
